stem:
Raghav has a square handkerchief with a painted design. He wants to know whether the design has mathematical symmetry.

Which two claims are correct?

options.text: A fold that maps the design onto itself shows symmetry.
Matching colours alone settle that the design is symmetric.
A turn that maps the design onto itself shows symmetry.
A definite pattern of matching parts is what creates symmetry by itself.

teacher.key_rationale: Symmetry is decided by a fold or turn that maps the design onto itself. Matching colours alone omit that transformation. Claiming a definite pattern creates symmetry reverses the relation.
